findings.summary: Production index.jsonl path is wrong: spec §1 step 2 and §0.1(a) evidence require reading /data/loop-engine/index.jsonl (production lane run_dirs live under /data/loop-engine/runs/...). scripts/check-drain-failures.mjs runtimeRoot() resolves via LOOP_ENGINE_RUNTIME_ROOT → ~/.config/loop-engine/config.json.runtimeRoot → LOOP_ENGINE_STATE → default ~/.loop-engine. None of these yield /data/loop-engine, and neither shipped deploy profile (profiles/deploy/local.env, agent-harness.env) sets LOOP_ENGINE_STATE/LOOP_ENGINE_RUNTIME_ROOT nor writes the config. So on a real production drain the scanner reads $HOME/.loop-engine/index.jsonl, misses the real index, and exits 3 ('index.jsonl not found') on every run — breaking Y1 (tick failure ⇒ loud fail, success ⇒ unchanged) in production. The test passes only by injecting LOOP_ENGINE_RUNTIME_ROOT, masking the path-resolution defect. The default must resolve to /data/loop-engine (or the scanner must read the loop-engine state root the rest of bin/ already assumes at /data/code/self/loop-engine).
